text:
maria: Quick share from today's 40B onboarding sweep across regions — wanted to capture kernel/latency tradeoffs and a sizing sketch. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/40b-onboard

josh: nice, can you paste per-GPU throughput at our suggested concurrency targets?

maria: short numbers (seq=512, conc=12): H100 FP16 -> p50 45ms / 230 rps, H100 q4f16 -> p50 52ms / 300 rps, A100 FP16 -> p50 60ms / 200 rps, A100 q4f16 -> p50 68ms / 280 rps. p99 tails: H100-q4 ~120ms, A100-q4 ~220ms (seq>1024 spikes).

lee: kernel root cause: on A100 the q4 path hits a fallback GEMM kernel past token~1024 (vectorization loss). H100 keeps mma-specialized kernels so tails are much flatter.

ops: ops data point — APAC night surge last week pushed peak qps 2.1x for 30m, so we need ~30% headroom for autoscale to avoid queued requests.

nina: quick quality check: eval-run against long-dialog suite shows q4f16 chrF down 0.8 pts vs fp16 on multi-turn >1500 tokens. Short-form is fine. link: https://evals.redwood.internal/40b/longdialog

maria: actionable proposal: hold q4 in eu for cost experiments but gate for long-form traffic. For Dedicated pools, propose initial counts and concurrency targets:
```
us-west (primary, low-latency): 24 H100 nodes, concurrency target 10, burst to 16
eu-west (balanced): 12 A100 nodes, concurrency target 8, burst to 12
APAC (warm standby): 6 mixed GPUs, concurrency target 6, burst to 10
autoscale headroom target: 30% (scale-up threshold p95 > 120ms for 5m)
```

josh: can we justify 24 H100? what's runway if traffic doubles?

maria: simple runway calc: at conc=10 per-GPU rps ~190 (fp16 baseline), 24 GPUs -> ~4560 rps baseline, with 30% headroom -> effective peak ~5900 rps, which covers ~1.3x. For 2x we need ~48 GPUs or aggressive bursting.

lee: warmup/KV cache note — hot prompt set shows 15% latency improvement after warm slab (warm state TTL ~2h). Recommend slot warmup for top 10% routes.

ops: I'll add to runbook: scale policy snippet and playbook checklist. draft autoscale rules:
```
- scale-up when p95 > 120ms for 5m OR queued_requests > 50 for 2m
- scale-down when p95 < 90ms for 10m AND cpu_gpu_util < 40% for 15m
- emergency fallbacks: route to hosted-slim model variant if p99 > 500ms
```

ci-bot: perf job 1739987656 finished: all smoke tests passed, detailed failures: A100-q4 p99 spike at seq=2048. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1739987656/logs

josh: good catch. let's gate q4 for long-seq profiles until we have kernel fix or split routing.

lee: kernel mitigation ideas: 1) sequence-aware routing (route seq>1024 to FP16/A100 fast path), 2) micro-batching tweak to keep GEMM shapes favorable, 3) push quant kernel patch (still in research).

ops: action items — I'll provision the proposed pools as draft tickets, add autoscale rules, and schedule a 1hr runbook review. maria, can you open the provisioning PR with tags: dedicated/40b/onboard?

maria: yep will open PR and add perf artifacts + eval links. thanks all. :)
